🍁Fall Event happening now!🍁

🌐 Welcome to WikiRace! 🌐
The Roblox wiki racing game where you jump from article to article to reach the target—right from your own virtual laptop!

🎲 Start at a random article.
🎯 Be the first to reach the target article!
🔗 You can only travel by clicking links inside each page
🧠 Use knowledge, strategy, and unexpected connections
🏆 Set wiki speedrunning records!

✨ FEATURES:
💻 Browse real encyclopedia articles inside Roblox!
🏁 Race friends across multiple game modes!
🎨 Customize your laptop, theme, cursor, and more!
⚔️ Race 1v1 against other players in Ranked games!
🏆 Earn XP, coins, and leaderboard spots!

📚 WikiRace! is an independent project, not endorsed by or affiliated with the Wikimedia Foundation. Our article collection uses automated filtering to remove unsuitable topics and problematic words for a more child-friendly experience. Article content is used under CC BY-SA 4.0, with sources and modifications identified in-game.
